origin: Root proposed these consequences after freezing the966 manual readback; bounded producer checked the unchanged grammar and algebra. This is not an independent native finding or a statistical test.

triple.logical_words: Three identical consecutive complete logical words must all be subject terms. Predicate endings, standard/closure endings, literal-name endings and rr-free ordinary subject roots distinguish the grammatical roles. A clause boundary cannot pass between identical such words.
triple.literal_minimum: A nonempty literal name has at least2+6=8 working units. Therefore a complete subject term of length below8 is an ordinary rr-free root.
triple.physical_group_qualification: The outer members of three identical physical groups could in principle be fragments of continued words. Do not claim all three are complete logical subjects merely from physical group identity. For lengths6 or7 the middle member cannot be a continuation marker, whose length is3. Nor can it be a fragment: every nonempty fragment of a broken word touches a continuation marker, whereas both its neighbours are the same non-marker group.
triple.middle_member_proof: If that complete middle word were a predicate, the next equal physical group would have to be a complete subject or a prefix fragment of a subject. A predicate contains rr and cannot be a prefix of an rr-free root; it cannot start NAME_OPEN=rrp either: a root starting rr is forbidden, and the one-unit root r followed by a comparator begins rrr, not rrp. If the middle word were a standard, the preceding equal group would have to be a complete subject or a suffix fragment of one. A standard ends rrd or rrs; neither can end an rr-free root or a literal name ending rrf. Hence the middle member is a subject. At lengths6 or7 it is an ordinary rr-free root.
triple.conditional_application: Using only the triple forms and reader scopes supplied by root: okaiin has adjacent ii and length6, so a global drawing bijection cannot map control r to native working i. qokeedy has adjacent ee and length7, so it cannot map r to native working e in the supplied IT/ZL cases. No RF qokeedy claim, no replacement RF example and no new native query are made.
triple.ceiling: This only excludes particular control-r assignments under the fixed22-unit/full-physical-group contract and unchanged continuation grammar. It does not exclude all bijections, select a word meaning or establish native grammatical roles. Length3 continuation-marker cases and cropped populations are not covered by the stated physical-triple refinement.

cost.variables: C=clauses, N=written subject occurrences, b=continued-word breaks, M=complete messages, Z=negated clauses, P=physical groups, G=physical working-unit drawings, A=physical groups containing the repeated control unit rr under the one fixed drawing mapping. All messages are complete and nonempty; C>=M>=1, N>=C, and all paired continuation markers are included.
cost.group_identity: P=N+2C+3b. Each clause contributes its subjects plus one predicate and one standard. A break replaces one group by two fragments and adds two marker groups, a net increase of3.
cost.drawing_lower_bound: G>=N+2C+3C+6C+3Z+3M+6b=P+9C+3Z+3M+3b. The N+2C underlying roots/terms each cost at least one drawing; comparison suffixes cost3C, standard plus clause closure6C, negation3Z, message closure3M, and paired continuation markers6b. Names and longer roots only increase this bound.
cost.rr_group_lower_bound: Before splitting, the2C predicate/standard words each contain rr. Splitting can remove an original rr-bearing group from that count only if that word is broken; the number of such affected words is at most b. Other surviving fragments can only help. Every break adds two rr-bearing marker groups. Thus A>=2C-b+2b=2C+b. Extra rr-bearing literal subjects are not needed for this conservative bound.
cost.subject_ratio: If P>=3A, then A>b and C<=(A-b)/2. Therefore N/C=(P-3b)/C-2 >=2(P-3b)/(A-b)-2 >=2P/A-2. The last difference before subtracting2 is2b(P-3A)/(A(A-b))>=0. For b=0 the same conclusion needs no P>=3A restriction.
cost.population_scope: These equations are not licensed for strict interior groups, cropped paragraphs, missing line-edge continuation markers or a selected packet lacking complete-message accounting. They do not by themselves give a manuscript fit or rejection.
